description.value: Steed Cycles is a full-service bicycle shop in North Vancouver billing itself as 'Canada's Premier Bike Shop,' carrying a broad roster of premium brands including Specialized, Santa Cruz, Cervélo, Giant, and Rocky Mountain across mountain, road, gravel, city, and electric categories. The shop runs a dedicated service department alongside a comprehensive apparel and accessories department stocked with well-known touring and bikepacking brands. It is one of the North Shore's most complete cycling retail and service destinations for riders of all disciplines.
